title: Maybe for 8-10 year olds
text:
The 8-13 box arrived Friday and I'm underwhelmed. Maybe an 8-10 year old would be interested in this magic themed chemistry set, but my 12 year old was totally uninterested. I'll pass it on to a younger nephew, but I think that they need to look at that suggested age range, and reduce it significantly.

The plain brown box as packaging, with a small booklet and bag of "stuff" was also not very exciting, possibly contributing to the lack of excitement.
